mechanism: HourInRange wrap-around checks set bits for Sydney/Tokyo/London/NewYork in a single session mask; CountActiveSessions>1 flags overlaps; DominantSessionFromMask priority (NY>London>Tokyo>Sydney) picks the live map. Overlap-only notify mode treats multi-session windows as high-liquidity regimes vs single-session/idle.
data_needed: Broker-local session open/close hours; TimeCurrent hour; optional GMT offset for markers.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M5 demo alerts; any Symbol/_Period with configurable session hours
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a compact bitmask liquidity-regime feature (idle / single session / named overlap) without needing separate clocks—usable as a calendar-style liquidity sensor.
quote: The three-hour London-New York overlap accounts for only 12.5% of the trading day but generates 40% of EURUSD movement.

mechanism: ATR(Period) × ATR_SL_Factor / ATR_TP_Factor sets dynamic stop and target distances; first-trade lots from equity risk / (SL points × point value). IsTradingAllowed blocks when SYMBOL_SPREAD exceeds MaxSpreadPoints×10. Circuit breaker also pauses on consecutive losses or peak-equity drawdown %.
data_needed: ATR series; account equity/balance; SYMBOL_SPREAD; peak equity global; consecutive-loss counter.

quote: The volatility management section incorporates ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit calculations, ensuring that the trade exits automatically scale with market volatility rather than using fixed pip distances.

mechanism: Find RSI high/low pivots with bilateral strength N; pair pivots within MaxPivotDistance; regular bearish = price HH + RSI LH (min strength); regular bullish = price LL + RSI HL; optional CheckRSIBreak requires RSI to cross the older pivot level within 10 bars after the newer pivot before signaling.
data_needed: RSI(period,price) buffer; OHLC for pivot prices; InpMinDivergenceStrength; InpRequireRSIBreak.

why_new_for_mis: Adds an RSI-break confirmation gate on classic divergence—MIS gets a delayed-but-validated momentum-exhaustion change event rather than premature pivot pairs.
quote: As price makes its 3rd or 4th lower low (LL) near the channel's lower support boundary, the RSI forms a higher low (HL).

mechanism: Find swing highs/lows with SwingStrength; score rising (higher lows) / falling (lower highs) channels by recency + CountChannelTouches (tolerance in pips on both rails) + height; require MinTouchesPerLine×2; invalidate if recent bars break channel by ~1%. Rising→sell setup, falling→buy setup.
data_needed: LookbackBars OHLC; SwingStrength; MinTouchesPerLine; TouchTolerancePips; MinChannelLengthBars/HeightPct.
why_new_for_mis: Touch-validated equidistant channels as a structure-regime sensor with explicit invalidation—MIS can gate other signals by active rising/falling consolidation.
quote: By requiring multiple price interactions with both channel boundaries, this system ensures detected channels have been tested and validated by market action rather than being mathematical artifacts.

mechanism: Utility EA enforces daily/weekly/monthly P/L caps, consecutive-loss limit, max drawdown from equity peak, max position size, and emergency stop; force-closes positions and blocks new deals via OnTick/OnTradeTransaction. No market-regime or price sensor is built.

quote: Unlike signal-generating EAs, this utility acts as a foundational layer of protection. It does not tell us when to trade but ensures us how to trade strictly within the guardrails that we define.

mechanism: Modular Arch library: mean (constant/zero/AR/HAR/ARX/HARX) + vol process (constant/ARCH/GARCH p,o,q,power) + residual distribution; joint MLE via Alglib MinNLC log-likelihood; ArchModelResult.conditional_volatility in-sample; forecast() analytic/simulation/bootstrap horizons for mean/variance/residual_variance.
data_needed: Return/price series vector; ArchParameters (lags, garch_p/q/o, dist); optional exogenous matrix; holdout indices.

quote: In this article, we present an MQL5 library for modeling and forecasting volatility. The primary goal is to provide a flexible tool for specifying different types of volatility processes.

mechanism: archlmtest regresses squared (optionally standardized) residuals on their lags via OLS; Wald/chi-square stat and pvalue(); p>0.05 ⇒ residuals homoskedastic (model adequate); p≤0.05 ⇒ remaining ARCH effects. Lags default ~12*(n/100)^(1/4).
data_needed: Fitted residuals + conditional_volatility vectors; lag count.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same library; AUDUSD D1 demo context
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a formal post-fit volatility-adequacy sensor: whether conditional heteroskedasticity remains after a vol model.
quote: If the p-value is larger than 0.05, it is a pass. Meaning we cannot reject the null hypothesis. This indicates that the residuals are homoskedastic (constant variance), meaning the ARCH/GARCH model has done its job.

mechanism: IsSwingHigh/LowSimple over LookBackPeriod with SwingSensitivity; collect swing highs/lows; zone high/low = max/min of cluster ± asymmetric ZonePadding×_Point (more pad above support / below resistance); draw filled rectangles + mid HLINE; publish GLOBAL_SUPPORT/RESISTANCE_* for EAs; refresh every tick.
data_needed: high/low series; LookBackPeriod; SwingSensitivity; ZonePadding points.

mechanism: Load same SRProbabilityZones params; if close inside support→evaluate bullish patterns only; if inside resistance→bearish only (library of ~24 patterns incl. engulfing, pin/hammer, marubozu, harami, stars). Alert/email/push/sound on confirm; MaxAlertsPerDay throttle.

mechanism: Detect swing H/L nodes; directed edges older→newer alternating types; BFS from mode root (prev bars / prev days / yesterday); ClassifyNodeDirection via HH/HL vs LH/LL vs prior same-type swing; bias = Σ ±weight / Σweight with weight=1/(1+0.2×BFS_level) → [-1,+1]; allowBuy/Sell if |bias|>BiasThreshold; optional recent swing-break confirm; close on bias flip.

mechanism: MQL5 harvester logs same-direction base→exit candle pairs with ExitToBaseRatio, Base_BodyATR, Exit_BodyATR; Python EDA + KMeans on strong exits (ratio>1.5) finds Cluster0 core impulse (median ratio≈3.21, mean Base_BodyATR≈0.22, Exit_BodyATR≈0.67); optimized rules MinExitBodyRatio=3.0, MaxBaseBodyATR=0.3, MinExitBodyATR=0.5 for supply/demand zone creation.

mechanism: Four zone detectors: (1) displacement = ATR×MinCandleSizeATR range, <30% overlap neighbors, body>60% range, optional vol≥1.5×avg; (2) unfilled/FVG 3-candle imbalance or large-then-small fill<30%; (3) structure CHoCH via swing LH/HL vs prior swing; (4) liquidity sweep wick beyond prior H/L then reverse close. Strength 0–1; mitigate when price trades through entire zone; opacity∝strength.
